messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-host opportunity: Product launch webinar with Nimbus Health

Hi Liam,

Hope you had a great week — I'm Vanessa on the partnerships team at Redwood. We loved the notes you shared about Nimbus's new scheduling product and think there is a great story for a short co-hosted webinar: a 30–40 minute session with ~20 minutes of presentation + 10–15 minutes of Q&A that walks through the migration to Redwood Inference and the operational wins you saw.

High-level ask: would Nimbus be open to co-hosting a launch webinar with Redwood the week of Aug 24? We typically handle promotion + registration and would feature a Nimbus technical/product speaker to cover the migration timeline, KPIs (latency/cost/availability), and a short demo or screenshots.

If interested, can you share: 1) who at Nimbus would present (name/title), 2) any blackout dates in Aug, and 3) whether Nimbus is comfortable with the session being recorded for on-demand distribution?

I attached a one-page draft agenda to show structure. If you want a different format, we can adapt.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to sync.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: draft_agenda.docx (Webinar agenda stub)

Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700

Vanessa — thanks for the note and the thoughtful agenda. We'd be interested in doing this with Redwood.

A few quick answers:
- Speaker: Nina Patel, Senior Product Manager (she led the rollout). I've cc'd her.
- Recording: we are usually okay but will need a short speaker release and confirmation that any customer data shown will be scrubbed.
- Dates: week of Aug 24 works for us but prefer Aug 26 or 27.

Nina — would you be able to present and join a single 45-minute dry run the week prior?

Appreciate you handling promotion — can you share the typical audience profile and the cross-promo assets you need from us?

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | Nimbus Health

- Dry runs: propose Tue Aug 18 10:00–10:45 PT or Thu Aug 20 14:00–14:45 PT. Please pick one and I'll reserve. Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood-webinars/dry-run
